review_goal: Determine the defensible overlap treatment for ORI OH0252700 and whether Ohio State University Police in Columbus should resolve to Columbus, Franklin County, a custom Columbus-campus footprint, or broad overlap pending better geometry.
bottom_line: Treat OH0252700 as a custom Ohio State Columbus-campus footprint rather than Columbus city or Franklin County. The official record ties OSUPD primary policing to university property and the Columbus campus, while off-campus University District work is a limited Columbus mutual-aid / joint-patrol function and Clery noncampus geography is broader than the police footprint. Build the footprint from the official Columbus campus property system and adjacent public-property edges; do not auto-include the wider city, county, University District neighborhoods, or remote Wexner / airport sites without direct current OSUPD service evidence.
